headline: Linn of Mercy Reignites as Island and Central Fronts Shake
war_summary: Linn of Mercy has violently reawakened after an earlier lull, recording eight base ownership transfers across Lathair and Outwich Ranch over the past two hours, leaving one position in neutral ruins. Meanwhile, intense skirmishing continues unabated in Godcrofts and Palantine Berm, where Isawa, Fleecewatch, Vendett, and Windburn Landing sustained continuous assaults and repeated captures. Marban Hollow remains heavily contested with six recent base exchanges centered on Checkpoint Bua and Oster Wall, keeping the sector fractured. Across the eastern front, Stlican Shelf experienced massive casualty spikes exceeding twenty-two hundred combatants in two hours alongside renewed fighting around Breaker Town. Farranac Coast and Callahan's Passage also logged sharp casualty accelerations under heavy fighting despite steady lines, while Weathered Expanse maintained rapid attrition across three contested bases reduced to no-man's-land.
